posts.name: LACK OF SUBTLETY
posts.cooked:
One of the many things I am thankful for about the Sentinels video game is that it clears up some mistakes I had been making in my regular game play.

For instance:

- I did not know that when multiple cards modified damage type you got to select the order. Good to know.

- I had been completely underappreciative of Fanatic's Divine Focus, thinking it happened on each of HER turns rather than EVERY turn

 

What did you run into that you found out you had been playing wrong?

posts.name: eugeneruss
posts.cooked:
Absolute Zero sickness just done vs. Voss...tricks the app helped my figure out.

Ab Zero has two impales, one cold snap out

Twist the Ether, Cryo chamber, both modules, thermal shockwave.

Voss, 1 minion, mystic defenses from Ruins of Atlantis

  • Start of turn: deal damage with both impales, cold snap on minion first (killing it), all boosted by +1 with twist but kept cold
  • Play hoarfrost, cold to voss, fire to mystic defenses, cold to myself and fire twistedinto cold to myself to heal up a bit more
  • Activate thermal shockwave. Cold to Voss, cold to mystic defenses, cold twisted to fire to Absolute Zero, damage sent back to mystic defenses to destroy it
  • Resulting fire sent (17 +  1 for twist - 1 for cyro) into to Absolute Zero, twisted into Psychic to deal 18 psychic to Voss and kill him.

Voss had started that turn with almost 30 hit points.

In that game, I'd had Absolute Zero very near death, but Font of Power played that Thermal Shockwave on him, and he got cryo out on his turn. Did a shockwave with the 12 points of fire damage reversed into cold to heal himself up, for the remaining two turns he had the most hit points of any hero.

We only let the trigger the first time a hero took damage, not the first time each target did them damage. They're a lot more useful now.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Ah yeah, that's always a handy one...you can take out a whole bunch of zombies or minions or whatever if you have a damage buff...in fact, this happened once versus Gloomweaver. We had Ra, Expatriette, and probably Legacy (there was a damage buff or two active). A cultist would come out and get hit for buffed Hairtrigger damage from Expatriette, then hit Ra and get finished off by his Flame Barrier...then turn into a Zombie which would get insta-killed by Hairtrigger :D.

Also bear in mind with the retaliation effects that they kick in if you get hit by a fellow hero as well (eg Haka on a Rampage), or if you hit yourself. But it works the same for villains too, for example if you can redirect a hit of Baron Blade's back at him when he has a Backlash Field active, said field will then activate and hit him as well because he dealt himself damage :D.
